findings.detail: All 11 flagged values are drawn from the comparative-period schedule rather than the March 31, 2026 schedule; representative issuer pairs prove the period leak.

rationale: This is a Class 2 multi-row period-selection defect. The flag reports March 31, 2026 but its cited values match December 31, 2025 source rows. Representative exact mismatches are Leaf Home 4.25% flagged/comparative versus 5.25% current, Garda World 3.00% versus 2.75% current, and Reliable Doors 5.00% versus 5.50% current. The current-period schedule rows are the controlling anchors, so the 11-row comparative leakage is a real extraction error.
